summary.name: AgentVerse
summary.one_liner: AgentVerse is a multi-agent framework from an arXiv paper (2023) that lets groups of LLM-based agents dynamically adjust their composition to collaborate on tasks and study emergent social behaviors.
keywords: group of ai agents working together
use_cases: studying emergent social behaviors among AI agents
deploying groups of LLM agents on tasks
comparing group agents against a single agent
exploring strategies to improve multi-agent teamwork
summary.what_it_does: The paper proposes AgentVerse, a multi-agent framework in which groups of LLM-powered agents collaboratively and dynamically adjust their composition to accomplish tasks. The authors report experiments showing that agent groups can outperform a single agent. They also analyze social behaviors that emerge among agents during collaboration, noting both positive and negative ones. Based on these observations, the paper discusses possible strategies to encourage positive behaviors and mitigate negative ones. The page itself is an arXiv abstract listing with version history (v1 August 2023, v3 October 2023) and says code will soon be released on GitHub under OpenBMB.
